q1.question: Is Convessa official WhatsApp?
q1.answer: No, Convessa uses the WhatsApp Web API to connect to your account. It's the same technology used by WhatsApp Web in your browser.

q2.question: Can I use Convessa with WhatsApp Business?
q2.answer: Yes! Convessa works with both personal WhatsApp AND WhatsApp Business accounts. You can use any type of WhatsApp account.

q3.question: Is my data secure?
q3.answer: Absolutely. We use end-to-end encryption and don't store any messages. Your data stays between you and WhatsApp.

q4.question: What's the message limit per minute?
q4.answer: To prevent spam, we limit to 20 messages per minute on the free plan and 100 messages/minute on paid plans.
